headline: California Potential Quartz Ban Prompts Shift to Alternative Materials
summary: Contractors and retailers are increasingly adopting alternative materials to avoid health risks associated with silica dust generated from cutting engineered quartz.
why: Potential regulatory bans on engineered quartz force manufacturers and construction supply chains to pivot toward substitute products.

impacts.name: Building Materials
impacts.why: Regulatory restrictions on quartz force a redistribution of market share toward alternative surfacing materials.
